description:
Title: Chainsaw

You produce custom chainsaws on demand.
Your chainsaws have at least 5 properties such as length of the "guide bar" (Schwertlaenge), chain width, electric or motor chainsaw.
After your customer told you the properties, you can start ordering the parts from various online sources (in parallel).
After the parts arrive you have to do a manual inspection of all parts, and then assemble the parts.
During production, you regularly send updates to your customer.
After producing the first saw you send it to your customer.
If he likes it, the rest of his order are produced.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties specified"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw Producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Properties" name="Properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Properties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Update" name="Production update" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirst" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw Production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Properties" name="Properties received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Properties" messageRef="Msg_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from online sources">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Production_Split" name="Start production and updates"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Inspect" name="Inspect all parts manually"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble chainsaw"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirst" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Customer_Decision" name="Customer likes the saw?"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce remaining chainsaws of the order"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Remaining order produced"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotLiked" name="Remaining order not produced"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdate" name="Send production update to customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateSent" name="Production update sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Catch_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Catch_PartsArrived" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Task_Inspect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Inspect" targetRef="Task_Assemble"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="Task_SendFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendFirst" targetRef="Catch_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Catch_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerLikesSaw == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision" targetRef="End_NotLiked">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerLikesSaw == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Task_SendUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="End_UpdateSent"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
